cards.text: とじていない三枚一組の資料を、一{}コピーしてください。
cards.en: Please make one complete copy of this three-sheet handout. Its pages are loose, not bound into a book; count complete copies, not individual sheets.
cards.note: 部 counts the complete copy, here all three sheets together. 一枚 would request one sheet, and とじていない explicitly says the pages are not bound or stapled together, so 冊 is not the requested unit. 一部 is いちぶ, without the contraction いっぷ. 組 (also 組み), セット (including ワンセット) and 一式 also express this one complete set.

cards.text: この一枚の申込書を、八{}コピーします。
cards.en: I will make eight copies of this one-sheet application form.
cards.note: Each complete copy is one sheet here, so both 部 and 枚 preserve the requested count. That overlap does not make copies and sheets identical in every document. Read 八部 as はちぶ, not はっぷ.

cards.text: 同じ本を六{}注文しました。
cards.en: I ordered six copies of the same bound book.
cards.note: 部 can count copies of the same publication, while 冊 counts the physical bound books. Both fit these six copies. 部 does not require the publication to consist of only one page.
